title: ACR MCP graphql_query Request v1
description: Input for the graphql_query tool: one GraphQL query over the allowed part of the product analytics schema (data_catalog section schema lists it), with its variables. Queries only: no mutation, subscription, fragment, directive or introspection. Aliases only on root fields. The organization always comes from your credential: never send orgId.

examples.query: query($ids: [String!]) { hotspots(input: {sinceUtc: "2026-09-01T00:00:00Z", untilUtc: "2026-09-28T00:00:00Z", repoIds: $ids, limit: 20}) { rows { repoId filePath riskScore } } }

query.description: The GraphQL query text: exactly one query operation over the root fields data_catalog section schema lists, selecting only listed fields, at most 8192 bytes. Repository and team ids are canonical ids taken from find_subjects or from a response: never build one.

variables.description: Values for the variables the query declares. A name the query does not declare is refused.

max_bytes.description: Upper bound for the size of the returned data in bytes. 0 or absent means the default, 32768; the largest is 262144. Data over the bound is refused with response_budget, never cut: select fewer fields or ask for less instead.
